## Summary

What changed and why?

## Change type

- [ ] Team or bot listing
- [ ] Website or API
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tooling, dependency, or repository governance

## Listing checks, when applicable

- [ ] I ran this recipe in Grok Bot end to end.
- [ ] The file is `teams/<slug>.md` or `bots/<slug>.md`.
- [ ] `slug` matches the filename and the public schema passes.
- [ ] Connectors, room members, routine owners, and guardrails are accurate.
- [ ] This contribution contains no credentials, private data, or advertisement.

## Merge checks

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally.
- [ ] Public claims match `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and `botteams.ai`.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior, or explained why none are needed.
- [ ] I did not commit secrets or personal data.

After merge, listing and website changes publish from `main`. All required
checks and approval from `@skillselion` must complete first.
